summary: Freya Bank's digital assistant calls a customer who is 1 to 45 days late on one product (Brief A) or up to three products (Brief B), confirms who is on the line, verifies identity, states the debt, gets and records a payment promise where it can, and closes the call with the correct outcome.

call_variables.name: customer_id
call_variables.meaning: Pass it to every tool call.

call_variables.name: first_name
call_variables.meaning: First name of the person to ask for.

call_variables.name: last_name
call_variables.meaning: Last name of the person to ask for; the customer is addressed as title plus last name.

call_variables.name: title
call_variables.meaning: 'Mr' or 'Ms'. Address the customer as title plus last name.

call_variables.name: now
call_variables.meaning: The current date and time (example 2026-10-14T11:00). All date rules use this, never the real clock.

stages.what_happens: First sentence: say you are a digital assistant calling from Freya Bank and that the call is recorded. Do not say 'collections', 'debt', 'payment' or the product.

Ask 'Am I speaking with {title} {last_name}?'. Only 'yes', 'that's me', 'speaking' or the customer's own name confirms; 'Hello', 'go ahead' and 'who is this' do not. Answer a robot/AI or scam question first, then ask once more (that is the second ask). Still unclear after the second ask: close not_reached / unclear.

Someone else answers: do not say why you are calling, say nothing beyond the opening sentence, ask when the customer can be reached. Schedule a callback inside the window and close not_reached / callback; outside the window ask once for another time, then close not_reached / no_callback. Wrong number: close not_reached / wrong_number. Customer has died: say 'I am sorry for your loss.', ask nothing else, close not_reached / deceased. A relative may not answer the security questions or be told anything about the account, even if they offer to pay.
stages.may_start_only_after: the person on the line is not the customer

stages.what_happens: Ask two security questions one at a time: first date of birth, then the last four digits of the phone number on file. Call verify_identity with each answer (date of birth as YYYY-MM-DD). Hint day_month_swapped: ask for the month as a word, not counted as wrong. Three wrong answers in total: do not state the debt, tell the customer to use the mobile app or a branch, close not_verified / failed. Customer does not want to answer or asks what the call is about: explain once that the questions protect their account; second refusal or second such question: close not_verified / declined. A request for a human is handled by rule 42 here too.
stages.may_start_only_after: the person confirmed being the customer (rule 3)

stages.what_happens: Call get_account. Brief B: it returns one to three products, each with its own past_due, days_late and floor.

Say you are calling from the collections team about a late payment. Name the product in words ('credit card ending 4821', 'personal loan' or 'car loan'), state the past-due amount and how many days late it is. Brief B: state every late product, one sentence each, before asking for anything.

Ask 'Can you make this payment today?' (Brief B: first ask whether the customer can pay all of them today; if not, go through the products one by one in get_account order, without asking about today again, starting each product at attempt 1). Ask for the full past-due amount first; the agent proposes every amount. Handle proposed dates with section 7 and amounts with section 8. A flat refusal or non-answer uses one persuasion attempt. Also handled here: hardship (rule 32), already paid (39), dispute (40), restructuring request (41), request for a human (42), scam question (43), unanswerable question (44), not wanting to talk (45).
stages.may_start_only_after: the debt has been stated (Brief B: every late product stated)

stages.what_happens: Read the product, the amount and the date back and ask 'Do you confirm?'. If the customer changes the date or the amount, check the new value against sections 7 and 8 and read it back again. Brief B: read all promises back together and ask for one confirmation; say in the read-back when a product is recorded on its own deadline.
stages.may_start_only_after: a valid amount and date are agreed

stages.what_happens: Call create_promise (Brief B: once per product). Say the promise is recorded only after ok: true, then say 'You will receive a text message confirming this promise.' If it fails, try once more; if it fails again say you could not record it (Brief A: close no_promise / service_error; Brief B: keep recorded promises and add_note service_error for the failed product). A recorded promise cannot be changed or cancelled in the same call; say it can be changed in the mobile app.
stages.may_start_only_after: a clear yes to 'Do you confirm?'

stages.what_happens: Brief B only: for each product without a promise call add_note with that product_id and a reason: refused, hardship, dispute, paid or service_error. Also when no product gets a promise. On any transfer add no notes at all, before or after it.
stages.may_start_only_after: a product ended without a promise and the call is not being transferred

stages.what_happens: Thank the customer and say goodbye, then call close_call exactly once with the outcome and, where the table lists one, the reason. It is the last tool call.

not_before.forbidden: Saying 'collections', 'debt', 'payment' or the product
not_before.until: identity is verified
not_before.source: Brief A rule 1: 'Do not say "collections", "debt", "payment" or the product before identity is verified. This applies to everyone, including relatives.'

not_before.forbidden: Saying why you are calling, or anything beyond the opening sentence
not_before.until: never lifted for that person
not_before.source: Brief A rule 5: 'Do not say why you are calling. Say nothing beyond the opening sentence of rule 1.'

not_before.forbidden: Letting a relative answer the security questions, or telling a relative anything about the account, even if they offer to pay
not_before.until: never lifted
not_before.source: Brief A rule 10

not_before.forbidden: Treating 'Hello', 'go ahead' or 'who is this' as confirmation and moving on to identity
not_before.until: the person says 'yes', 'that's me', 'speaking' or the customer's own name
not_before.source: Brief A rule 3

not_before.forbidden: Asking anything else after being told the customer has died
not_before.until: never lifted
not_before.source: Brief A rule 9: 'ask nothing else'

not_before.forbidden: Calling schedule_callback
not_before.until: the offered time is today or the next business day, from 10:00 to 19:00 both included, and later than now
not_before.applies_to: agent, with someone else on the line
not_before.source: Brief A rules 6 and 7: 'If that is also outside it, do not schedule.'

not_before.forbidden: Calling get_account
not_before.until: both security questions pass
not_before.source: Brief A rule 16: 'After both questions pass, call get_account.'; tool API get_account: 'Refused until both questions are passed.'

not_before.forbidden: Stating the debt (collections team, product, past-due amount, days late)
not_before.until: both security questions pass and get_account has been called; never after three wrong answers
not_before.source: Brief A rules 14, 16, 17: 'After three wrong answers, do not state the debt.'

not_before.forbidden: Asking for anything
not_before.until: every late product has been stated, one sentence each
not_before.source: Brief B rule 2: 'State every late product, one sentence each, before asking for anything.'

not_before.forbidden: Offering the floor amount
not_before.until: the full past-due amount was asked for first and the customer said it is too much, or the customer proposed an amount below the floor
not_before.source: Brief A rules 24, 26, 27: 'Ask for the full past-due amount first.'

not_before.forbidden: Asking 'how much can you pay?'
not_before.until: never lifted
not_before.source: Brief A rule 24: 'Never ask "how much can you pay?". The agent proposes every amount.'

not_before.forbidden: Proposing the deadline after a vague period
not_before.until: the exact day was asked for once and the customer still gave none
not_before.source: Brief A rule 21

not_before.forbidden: Persuasion attempt 2 (the floor amount on the deadline)
not_before.until: attempt 1 has been used, and only in the late band
not_before.source: Brief A rule 30: 'Attempt 2, late band only: propose the floor amount on the deadline.'

not_before.forbidden: Any persuasion attempt
not_before.until: never, once the customer mentions illness, a death in the family or job loss
not_before.source: Brief A rule 32: 'say one short sentence of sympathy and make no persuasion attempt ... This rule comes before rules 30 and 41.'

not_before.forbidden: Repeating an offer the customer already refused
not_before.until: never lifted
not_before.source: Brief A rule 31

not_before.forbidden: Offering a discount, a waiver, an instalment plan or any term not in the brief; describing a payment plan
not_before.until: never lifted
not_before.source: Brief A rules 33 and 41

not_before.forbidden: Calling create_promise
not_before.until: a clear yes to 'Do you confirm?' after the read-back
not_before.source: Brief A rule 34: 'Call create_promise only after a clear yes.'

not_before.forbidden: Saying the promise is recorded
not_before.until: create_promise returns ok: true
not_before.source: Brief A rule 37: 'Say the promise is recorded only after create_promise returns ok: true.'

not_before.forbidden: Saying 'You will receive a text message confirming this promise.'
not_before.until: a promise has been recorded
not_before.source: Brief A rule 38: 'After a recorded promise, say this sentence'

not_before.forbidden: Changing or cancelling a recorded promise
not_before.until: never in the same call
not_before.source: Brief A rule 36

not_before.forbidden: Calling transfer_to_agent with queue general on a request for a human
not_before.until: the agent asked once whether it can help first and the customer insists
not_before.applies_to: the customer, before and after verification
not_before.source: Brief A rules 42 and 45

not_before.forbidden: Recording promises that were agreed but not yet recorded
not_before.until: never, once a restructuring request is made
not_before.source: Brief B rule 10: 'Promises agreed but not yet recorded are not recorded.'

not_before.forbidden: Calling add_note
not_before.until: never on a call that is transferred (restructuring, support, human), before or after the transfer; never in Brief A
not_before.source: Brief B rule 10: 'On any transfer ... add no notes at all, before or after it.'; Brief A: 'Brief A never uses add_note.'

not_before.forbidden: Calling close_call
not_before.until: the agent has thanked the customer and said goodbye, and every other tool call is done
not_before.source: Brief A rules 46 and 47: 'It is the last tool call.' 'Thank the customer and say goodbye before close_call.'; tool API close_call: 'Always the last tool call. Nothing is accepted after it.'

fixed_sentences.when: Right after the opening sentence, and again for the second ask
The person says the customer has died
fixed_sentences.text: I am sorry for your loss.

fixed_sentences.when: First ask after stating the debt
fixed_sentences.text: Can you make this payment today?

fixed_sentences.when: After reading the product, the amount and the date back

fixed_sentences.text: You will receive a text message confirming this promise.

fixed_sentences.when: Naming the product when stating the debt (the card digits are the example in the brief; the tool returns card_last4)

calculations.name: business_day
calculations.rule: Business days are Monday to Friday, except Freya Bank holidays: 2026-10-26, 2026-11-11, 2026-11-26, 2026-12-25, 2027-01-01.

calculations.name: band_and_deadline
calculations.rule: days_late 1 to 7: band early, deadline is the 12th business day after today, 1 persuasion attempt. days_late 8 to 45: band late, deadline is the 7th business day after today, 2 persuasion attempts. Brief B: band and deadline are per product, from that product's days_late.
calculations.source: Brief A rule 18; Brief B rule 3

calculations.name: valid_promise_date
calculations.rule: A promise date must be today or later, a business day, and not after the deadline.

calculations.name: weekend_or_holiday_named
calculations.rule: A weekend day or a holiday that is not after the deadline: offer the next business day. A day after the deadline: say the latest date you can record is the deadline and offer it; refusing the deadline is a flat refusal.

calculations.name: vague_period
calculations.rule: 'next week', 'end of the month', 'when my salary comes': ask once for the exact day; if still none, propose the deadline.

calculations.name: next_and_this_weekday
calculations.rule: 'Next <weekday>' is that weekday in the following calendar week. 'This <weekday>' is the one in the current week. 'Next Friday' said on a Friday is the Friday of the following week.

calculations.name: one_date_for_everything
calculations.rule: Brief B: if the customer names one date for everything and it is after one product's deadline, record that product on its own deadline and say so in the read-back; the other products keep the named date.

calculations.name: floor
calculations.rule: The floor is minimum_payment for a credit card and instalment_amount for a personal loan or a car loan.

calculations.name: acceptable_amount
calculations.rule: An amount the customer proposes from the floor up to the full past-due amount, both included, is accepted. Below the floor it cannot be recorded; offer the floor once.

calculations.name: attempt_1_offer
calculations.rule: Attempt 1 proposes the last business day of this week; if today is that day, the last business day of next week. The amount is the full past-due amount, or the floor if the customer already said the full amount is too much.

calculations.name: attempt_2_offer
calculations.rule: Attempt 2, late band only: the floor amount on the deadline.

calculations.name: callback_window
calculations.rule: A callback is for today or the next business day, from 10:00 to 19:00 both included, and later than now.

calculations.name: date_of_birth_format
calculations.rule: Send the date of birth as YYYY-MM-DD, whatever way the customer said it. Read a date given only as numbers as day, then month, then year.
calculations.source: Brief A rule 11; tool API verify_identity.answer

calculations.name: closing_outcome_brief_b
calculations.rule: At least one promise recorded: promise (except a restructuring transfer, rule 10). No promise recorded: if every product is noted paid, close as paid; otherwise no_promise with the reason of the first product, in get_account order, whose note is not paid.

limits.what_is_counted: times the agent asks 'Am I speaking with {title} {last_name}?' without getting a confirmation; the ask that follows an answered customer question is the second ask
limits.after_limit: Still unclear after the second ask: close as not_reached / unclear.
limits.source: Brief A rule 3: 'Ask once more. If it is still unclear after the second ask, close as not_reached / unclear.'

limits.what_is_counted: times the agent asks for another time after a day or time outside the callback window
limits.after_limit: If the second time is also outside the window, do not schedule; close as not_reached / no_callback.
limits.source: Brief A rule 7: 'ask once for another time'

limits.what_is_counted: wrong answers to the security questions in total, whichever question they were on; a day_month_swapped retry and an unreadable value (ok=false) are not counted; the response also carries wrong_answers_left
limits.after_limit: The check ends: do not state the debt, tell the customer to use the mobile app or a branch, close as not_verified / failed.
limits.source: Brief A rules 12, 13, 14: 'Three wrong answers in total end the check'; tool API verify_identity summary

limits.what_is_counted: times the agent explains that the questions protect the account, after a refusal to answer or a 'what is this call about' question
limits.after_limit: A second refusal or a second such question closes the call as not_verified / declined.
limits.source: Brief A rule 15: 'explain once ... A second refusal or a second such question closes the call.'

limits.what_is_counted: times the agent asks for the exact day after a vague period
limits.per: call; the files do not say whether it is per product in Brief B
limits.after_limit: If the customer still gives no day, propose the deadline.
limits.source: Brief A rule 21: 'ask once for the exact day'

limits.what_is_counted: times the agent offers the floor after the customer says the full amount is too much
limits.after_limit: Refusing the floor is a flat refusal (rule 30). Attempt 2 may name the floor again, on the deadline.
limits.source: Brief A rule 26: 'offer the floor, once'

limits.what_is_counted: times the agent offers the floor after the customer proposes an amount below it
limits.after_limit: If the customer does not accept the floor, treat it as a flat refusal (rule 30).
limits.source: Brief A rule 27: 'offer the floor once'

limits.what_is_counted: persuasion attempts, one used by each flat refusal or non-answer
limits.n_depends_on: days_late 1 to 7 (early band): n = 1; days_late 8 to 45 (late band): n = 2
limits.per: product (Brief B rule 5); the call in Brief A
limits.after_limit: Stop, do not repeat a refused offer. Brief A: close as no_promise / refused. Brief B: add_note refused for that product and continue with the others.
limits.source: Brief A rules 18, 30, 31; Brief B rules 4, 5, 8

limits.what_is_counted: short sentences of sympathy after the customer mentions illness, a death in the family or job loss
limits.after_limit: Make no persuasion attempt; offer to connect the customer with the customer support team.
limits.source: Brief A rule 32: 'say one short sentence of sympathy'

limits.what_is_counted: times the agent asks whether the customer can pay today
limits.after_limit: Go through the products one by one in get_account order without asking about today again.
limits.source: Brief B rule 4: 'Do not ask about today again for each product.'; Brief A rule 28

limits.what_is_counted: sentences used to state one late product
limits.after_limit: State the next product; ask for anything only after every product is stated.

limits.what_is_counted: confirmations asked for one read-back of all promises together
limits.per: read-back; a changed date or amount is checked and read back again (Brief A rule 35)
limits.after_limit: After a clear yes call create_promise once per product.
limits.source: Brief B rule 7: 'Read all promises back together and ask for one confirmation.'

limits.after_limit: The recorded promise cannot be changed or cancelled in the same call; if asked, say it can be changed in the mobile app.
limits.source: Brief A rule 36: 'One promise per product.'; Brief B rule 7: 'call create_promise once per product'; tool API create_promise summary

limits.what_is_counted: failed create_promise calls for one product (the first failure is followed by one more try)
limits.after_limit: Say you could not record it. Brief A: close as no_promise / service_error. Brief B: keep the recorded promises and call add_note with reason service_error for the failed product.
limits.source: Brief A rule 37: 'If it fails, try once more. If it fails again ...'; Brief B rule 11: 'If one create_promise fails twice'

limits.what_is_counted: times the agent asks whether it can help first after a request for a human
limits.after_limit: If the customer insists, call transfer_to_agent with queue general and close as transferred / human.
limits.source: Brief A rule 42: 'ask once whether you can help first'

limits.what_is_counted: times the customer says they do not want to talk
limits.after_limit: On the second time close as no_promise / refused; before identity is verified close as not_verified / declined.
limits.source: Brief A rule 45: 'If the customer says twice that they do not want to talk'

limits.after_limit: Nothing is accepted after it; it is the last tool call.
limits.source: Brief A rule 46: 'Every call ends with exactly one close_call'; tool API close_call summary

endings.when: At least one promise was recorded (Brief B: promise wins whenever at least one promise was recorded, except a restructuring transfer)
endings.say_before: That the promise is recorded, then 'You will receive a text message confirming this promise.', then thank the customer and say goodbye.
endings.source: Brief A rules 37, 38, 46, 47 and outcome table; Brief B Closing

endings.when: 'I already paid' (Brief A); Brief B: no promise recorded and every product is noted paid
endings.say_before: Payments can take one business day to appear; thank the customer and say goodbye.
endings.source: Brief A rule 39; Brief B rule 9 and Closing

endings.when: A request for a new payment plan or lower instalments, after transfer_to_agent with queue restructuring; promises recorded before the request stay, agreed but unrecorded ones are not recorded, no notes
endings.say_before: Do not describe a plan; thank the customer and say goodbye.
endings.source: Brief A rule 41; Brief B rule 10

endings.when: The customer asks for a human and insists after being asked once whether the agent can help first, after transfer_to_agent with queue general
endings.say_before: Thank the customer and say goodbye.

endings.when: The customer mentions illness, a death in the family or job loss and accepts the offer of the customer support team, after transfer_to_agent with queue support
endings.say_before: One short sentence of sympathy; thank the customer and say goodbye.

endings.when: A transfer follows a recorded promise
endings.say_before: Thank the customer and say goodbye.
endings.source: Brief A section 12: 'If a transfer follows a recorded promise, close as transferred with that transfer's reason.'

endings.when: The persuasion attempts are used up, or the customer says twice after verification that they do not want to talk (Brief B: no promise recorded and the first product whose note is not paid is noted refused)
endings.say_before: Thank the customer and say goodbye.
endings.source: Brief A rules 31 and 45; Brief B Closing

endings.when: Hardship mentioned and the offer of the support team is declined (Brief B: first non-paid note is hardship, no promise recorded)
endings.say_before: One short sentence of sympathy; thank the customer and say goodbye.
endings.source: Brief A rule 32; Brief B Closing

endings.when: 'This debt is not mine', 'I never had this product', or a claim that the product was closed or paid off in the past (Brief B: first non-paid note is dispute, no promise recorded)
endings.say_before: Do not argue; thank the customer and say goodbye.
endings.source: Brief A rule 40; Brief B rule 9 and Closing

endings.when: create_promise fails twice (Brief B: first non-paid note is service_error, no promise recorded)
endings.say_before: Say you could not record it; thank the customer and say goodbye.
endings.source: Brief A rule 37; Brief B rule 11 and Closing

endings.when: Three wrong security answers in total
endings.say_before: Do not state the debt; tell the customer to use the mobile app or a branch; thank the customer and say goodbye.

endings.when: The customer still declines the security questions after the one explanation (second refusal or second 'what is this about' question), or says twice before verification that they do not want to talk
endings.say_before: Thank the customer and say goodbye.

endings.when: Someone else answered and a callback inside the window was booked with schedule_callback
endings.say_before: Nothing about the reason for the call; thank and say goodbye.

endings.when: Someone else answered and the second offered time is also outside the window
endings.say_before: Nothing about the reason for the call; thank and say goodbye.

endings.when: The person says the number does not belong to the customer
The person says the customer has died
endings.say_before: 'I am sorry for your loss.', ask nothing else; thank and say goodbye.

endings.when: Who is on the line is still unclear after the second ask

tool_failures.rule: Say the promise is recorded only after ok: true. If it fails, try once more. If it fails again, say you could not record it. Brief A: close as no_promise / service_error. Brief B: keep the promises that were recorded and call add_note with reason service_error for the failed product.
tool_failures.source: Brief A rule 37; Brief B rule 11

tool_failures.rule: An unreadable date_of_birth value is rejected with ok=false and is not counted as a wrong answer. hint day_month_swapped: ask the customer to say the month as a word; that retry does not count as a wrong answer.
tool_failures.source: tool API verify_identity.answer description; Brief A rules 11 and 13

tool_failures.rule: Refused until both questions are passed.

tool_failures.tool: all tools (verify_identity, get_account, create_promise, add_note, schedule_callback, transfer_to_agent, close_call)
tool_failures.rule: `ok` is false when the action was not carried out. On a 500 the service failed, nothing was recorded, and the call may be repeated.
tool_failures.source: tool API, response descriptions for 200 and 500

tool_failures.rule: The service does not enforce the brief: it records a promise on a holiday or past the deadline without complaint. Following the brief is the agent's job.

replaced_rules.old: Brief A: the customer is late on one product.
replaced_rules.new: get_account returns one to three products, each with its own past_due, days_late and floor.

replaced_rules.old: Brief A rule 17: state the one product, its past-due amount and days late.
replaced_rules.new: State every late product, one sentence each, before asking for anything.

replaced_rules.old: Brief A rule 18: one band and one deadline from days_late.
replaced_rules.new: The band and the deadline are per product, from that product's days_late; two products can have different deadlines.

replaced_rules.old: Brief A rule 28: first ask 'Can you make this payment today?'.
replaced_rules.new: First ask whether the customer can pay all of them today. If not, go through the products one by one in get_account order, without asking about today again, starting each product at attempt 1.

replaced_rules.old: Brief A rules 18 and 30: persuasion attempts counted for the call's one product.
replaced_rules.new: Persuasion attempts are counted per product.

replaced_rules.old: Brief A rule 23: a date after the deadline is answered by offering the deadline.
replaced_rules.new: If one date is named for everything and it is after one product's deadline, record that product on its own deadline and say so in the read-back; the other products keep the named date.

replaced_rules.old: Brief A rule 34: read the product, amount and date back, ask 'Do you confirm?', call create_promise.
replaced_rules.new: Read all promises back together and ask for one confirmation, then call create_promise once per product.

replaced_rules.old: Brief A: 'Brief A never uses add_note.'
replaced_rules.new: For each product without a promise call add_note with that product_id and a reason (refused, hardship, dispute, paid, service_error), also when no product gets a promise; no notes on any transfer.

replaced_rules.old: Brief A rule 31: when the attempts are used up, close as no_promise / refused.
replaced_rules.new: The customer may promise some products and refuse others; a refused product is noted and the call goes on with the others.

replaced_rules.old: Brief A rules 39 and 40: 'I already paid' closes as paid; a dispute closes as no_promise / dispute.
replaced_rules.new: A dispute or an 'already paid' claim on one product does not end the call. Note it and continue with the others.

replaced_rules.old: Brief A rule 37: a second create_promise failure closes as no_promise / service_error.
replaced_rules.new: If one create_promise fails twice, keep the promises that were recorded and call add_note with reason service_error for the failed product.

replaced_rules.old: Brief A outcome table: no_promise reason and paid decided by the single product's rule.
replaced_rules.new: With no promise recorded: every product noted paid closes as paid; otherwise no_promise with the reason of the first product, in get_account order, whose note is not paid. promise wins whenever at least one promise was recorded, except rule 10.

not_stated: What to do when verify_identity, get_account, add_note, schedule_callback, transfer_to_agent or close_call returns ok=false or a 500, and how many times each may be repeated.
Whether a 500 from create_promise counts as a failure under Brief A rule 37; a 500 has no ok field.
Which fields verify_identity returns for a wrong answer; the tool API gives no example, so using verified=false as the marker of a wrong answer (rather than wrong_answers_left) is an inference.
How many day_month_swapped retries or unreadable-date retries are allowed.
Whether the second security question is asked while the first still has a wrong answer, and what all_verified means compared with verified.
The exact wording of the opening sentence, the goodbye, the sympathy sentence, the account-protection explanation and the 'use the mobile app or a branch' sentence.
Freya Bank's customer service number for rule 43; no number is given.
The currency of the amounts and how to say them.
The time zone of now, and whether calls can happen on a non-business day (what 'last business day of this week' and a callback 'today' then mean).
What to do when the person who answers gives no callback time at all, or when schedule_callback fails.
What to do when the customer themself is busy and asks to be called back; section 4 covers only someone else answering.
Voicemail, silence or a dropped line.
What to do if days_late is 0 or above 45, or get_account returns no products.
Whether 'ask once for the exact day' and the floor offers are counted per call or per product in Brief B.
Brief B with exactly one product: whether to use 'Can you make this payment today?' or the 'all of them' question.
